bias.en: Bearish · oversold, down to the March lows
bias.zh: 看空 · 超卖，跌至 3 月低点

read.en: Applied Materials fell 13.6% on Nov 5 to $319.25, trading $316.95–349.99 on 2.2 times its 20-day average volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($367.04), 10-day ($383.36), 30-day ($445.27) and 100-day ($501.66) and the rising 200-day ($445.29). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13, below zero, with the histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 2 ($421.95), and RSI is 26, oversold.
read.zh: 应用材料 11月5日下跌 13.6%，收于 $319.25，盘中区间 $316.95–349.99，成交量为 20 日均量的 2.2 倍。股价位于下行的 5 日（$367.04）、10 日（$383.36）、30 日（$445.27）和 100 日均线（$501.66）以及上行的 200 日均线（$445.29）下方。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线下方，处于零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月2日起看空（$421.95），RSI 为 26，处于超卖区。

read.en: The gap lower broke the $362.9 Nov 4 low and the $355.3–359 March–April highs, and the close is the lowest since Feb 5. Resistance is $350 (Nov 5 high), then $355.3–363 (Mar 10 and Apr 1 highs, Nov 4 low) and $367 (5-day). Support is $315.7–317 (Nov 5, Mar 9 and Jan 20 lows), then $311.1 (Jan 23 low) and $297–298. A close above $350 would target $355–363; below $315.7, $311.
